jobs.title: International Treasury Manager
jobs.description:
The International Treasury Manager and Analysis position will oversee and manage all international treasury related activities located in China, Mexico, Brazil, Canada, Germany, United Kingdom, Italy, and any other international entity created in the future.  This position will also oversee and strategically direct the day-to-day, tactical work related to the international treasury function which are performed by the International Treasury Staff.
- A Bachelor's degree (BA, BS) or equivalent in the Accounting, Finance, Economics or related field
- International Finance degree and MBA a plus. Master's degree preferred
- 3-5 years of Treasury experience, financial analysis and business planning
- 7+ years of general experience
- Manage all international banking functions (including AutoZone and subsidiaries within China, Mexico, Brazil, Canada, Germany, United Kingdom, Italy, any other international entity created in the future) to ensure proper cash management, liquidity, capital and related activities are employed in-country and banking functions are managed to ensure the lowest cost and service levels are property maintained
- Manage the set-up of bank accounts, bank relationships, credit card processing, armored car, and all aspects related to cost of tender acceptance related to international entities
- Manage the international capital structure of the company which includes cash forecasts, working capital management, supplier financing, dividends, external investments (over $150MM), intercompany loans, and any external debt outside the US
- Analyze and manage key global commodity risk exposure data (e.g. foreign exchange, fuel, commodities) and develop models to quantify risks on an enterprise basis
- Develop and implement commodity (including foreign exchange) hedging strategies, if necessary, and ensure that such risks are communicated throughout the organization and provide commodity forecasting for planning purposes
- Evaluate current programs and developing analytic models to evaluate hedge effectiveness, and alternative hedging strategies from both an economics and accounting perspective
- Serve as the direct liaison to Risk Management for all international insurance coverage needs, including but not limited to, insurance information requests, local country insurance requirements and placements, surety bonds, and claims analysis
- Serve as the direct liaison to Credit Card Administration (PCard, T&E Card etc) for all international credit card needs including, correspondence with card holders and card issuers, receipt of rebates, and any other cardholder related issues that may come up.
- Performs special projects as directed by management
The International Treasury Manager and Analysis position will oversee and manage all international treasury related activities located in China, Mexico, Brazil, Canada, Germany, United Kingdom, Italy, and any other international entity created in the future. This position will also oversee and strategically direct the day-to-day, tactical work related to the international treasury function which are performed by the International Treasury Staff.

jobs.title: Distribution Center Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Come be a part of an energizing culture rooted in people with a commitment to delivering WOW! customer service. If you enjoy fast-paced, physical positions that gets you up and moving, then look no further.

AutoZone is the place for you!

We offer flexible work schedules in our world class distribution centers with climate-controlled workspaces.

This key position in AutoZone’s distribution center oversees and manages the daily operation of a single shift in the distribution center responsible for accuracy, productivity, on-time delivery and safety. The Operations Manager will regularly communicate with the DC Manager regarding process improvements, goals and metrics.
- Minimum of 5 years successful experience in a distribution/warehouse experience
- Must be flexible for shift schedule
- Cross functional experience overseeing multiple areas simultaneously
- Experience operating Powered Industrial Equipment (PIE)
- Exceptional people skills with the ability to communicate effectively
- Understand the demands of a fast paced work environment involving receiving, stocking, inbound, outbound, replenishment, returns/recalls, etc.
- P&L management experience preferred.
- Bilingual preferred, Spanish and English
- Manage and assist Advisors/Supervisors in multiple departments
- Ability to motivate and work in a team environment
- Ensure that all Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are on target for the operation
- Frequently attend and/or lead pre-shift meetings in different departments to communicate and prioritize assignments, safety issues and extra tasks
- Mentor, train and develop Advisors for career progression
- Develop and share best practices across shifts
- Drive continuous improvement to safety, quality, cost and delivery
- Communicate new policies and procedures to Advisors and AutoZoners
- Maintains a safe working environment while ensuring AutoZoners are implementing those practices including PPE (Personal Protective Equipment)
- Ability to work in a Safety Sensitive environment
- Other duties as assigned
This key position in AutoZone’s distribution center oversees and manages the daily operation of a single shift in the distribution center responsible for accuracy, productivity, on-time delivery and safety.
